turns.caption: Stay · 24/7 Living Voice-First ADHD Companion & Autonomous Task Engine
turns.text: Hi, I am Stay. I am a twenty-four-seven living voice companion and autonomous executive agent built for the exact moment ADHD freeze hits.

turns.speaker: stay
turns.caption: 60fps Spring-Physics Parametric Sculpture · Lotus → Letterform Gem → Ice Cream Cone → Creative Star
turns.text: As you speak, my sixty-frame-per-second spring-physics sculpture smoothly transforms in real time—flowing from an eight-petal botanical lotus, to a faceted sapphire letterform gem, to a sculpted ice cream cone reward.

turns.speaker: user

turns.text: Hi Stay... ugh, are you there?

turns.speaker: stay
turns.caption: Zero-Friction Intake · 'Dump whatever is in your head—no need to organize it.'
turns.text: Hi! I'm right here with you. Take a slow breath and dump whatever is bouncing around in your head—you don't have to organize it for me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.caption: Unfiltered ADHD Brain-Dump · 10 Tabs Open · Landlord Lease Letter · Overdue Q3 VAT Taxes
turns.text: Honestly, uhh, my brain is completely fried right now. I have like ten tabs open, my landlord is asking for a lease letter, my quarterly VAT taxes are overdue, and I'm just doomscrolling because I don't even know where to start.

turns.speaker: stay
turns.caption: 24/7 Autonomous Agent Pre-Drafts Landlord & VAT Email + Live Personal ADHD Brain Study
turns.text: Pause right there—I've got you. Watch my sculpture bloom into a calming lotus and crystallize into a letterform gem. Instead of just giving advice, my twenty-four-seven agent already pre-drafted your landlord and VAT reply right here, shrinking three hours of dread into forty-five seconds, while mapping your live dopamine and working-memory load.

turns.speaker: user
turns.caption: Dopamine Reward Anchor · 'You already drafted the email?! Remind me I get ice cream after!'
turns.text: Wait, you already pre-drafted the email for me and shrunk it to forty-five seconds?! Okay, I can actually do this! Hey, remind me I can grab ice cream right after I finish.

turns.speaker: stay
turns.caption: Real-Time Smooth Morph → Sculpted Ice Cream Cone & Soft-Serve Swirl · Saved to Memory
turns.text: Watch my sculpture smoothly transform into a strawberry soft-serve ice cream cone with a golden waffle base so your brain can see the reward waiting for you! I've also saved that reward to your permanent cognitive memory.

turns.speaker: user
turns.caption: Hands-Free AGI Voice Commands · 'Show me memory, and then show me chat history!'
turns.text: That transformation is so smooth! Show me memory, and then show me chat history!

turns.speaker: stay
turns.caption: Architecture · AssemblyAI Universal-3 Pro (24kHz Single-WebSocket) + Groq gpt-oss-120b
turns.text: Under the hood, Stay streams twenty-four kilohertz PCM audio over a single full-duplex WebSocket to AssemblyAI's Universal-Three Pro Voice Agent API—delivering sub-second turn-taking, live barge-in, ADHD keyterm boosting, and thirty-two language detection.

turns.text: Paired with Groq's ultra-fast GPT-OSS one-twenty-B model, Stay autonomously drafts user work, tracks longitudinal executive-function phenotypes, enforces deterministic pre-LLM crisis and medication safety gates, and exports clinician-ready PDF reports.
